title: Final Pressure Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the pressure as p = NkT/V.

title: Final Entropy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the entropy as S = Nk(3 ln kT + ln(8πV/Nh^3c^3) + 4).

title: Final Specific Heat Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the specific heat as c = 3Nk.

title: Correct Use of Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the partition function and its implications for the calculations.

title: Pressure Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in deriving pressure from the partition function.

title: Entropy Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct steps in calculating entropy from the partition function.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of equations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expressions.
